text: Some journeys are about more than progress. They are about what happens behind the scenes.
Years of work. Ideas built with purpose. A vision that deserves to move forward.
But sometimes, the journey faces challenges no one sees.
A published account describes alleged hacking, tracking and stalking, and accidents it says were deliberately engineered, all aimed at stopping the progress of Sports Science Technology.
When the work is challenged... when the journey is tested... the question is not just how far you have come.
Because progress is not defined by the obstacles placed in its path. It is defined by the determination to keep moving.
The work continues. The vision moves forward.
Sports Science Technology. The journey is far from over.
